peg.peg_mechanism_score_basis: MEASURES THE MECHANISM ON PAPER, AND IT IS THE HIGHEST SCORE ON THIS ASSET BY SOME MARGIN — WHICH IS THE THING TO BE CAREFUL ABOUT. Reserve-backed by a fiat-stable basket with an oracle-priced FPMM, strong by design. The unit holds: −7.6bp, market 0.99924. ⚠️⚠️ BUT THE PEG HOLDING IS NOT EVIDENCE THE RESERVE IS WHOLE. The feed reports collateral_ratio 91.21 — an $1,325,631.79 DEFICIT on $13,758,936.23 of backing. ⚠️ A MECHANISM CAN DEFEND PAR ON AN UNDERCOLLATERALIZED BOOK FOR A LONG TIME, AND A TIGHT PEG BESIDE A 7.0 WILL READ AS CONFIRMATION OF SOLVENCY TO ANY READER WHO DOES NOT SEE THE BACKING AXIS. These two axes disagree on this asset and the disagreement is the finding — read them together or not at all.
peg.peg_mechanism_score_cross_axis: ⚠️ DO NOT CITE THE −7.6bp DEVIATION AS EVIDENCE OF BACKING QUALITY. Observed par is what the mechanism produces; whether there are assets behind it is axis 2, and axis 2 currently says 91.21%.

backing.backing_score_basis: ⚠️⚠️ MEASURES AGGREGATE MENTO RESERVE COVERAGE, AND IT IS BELOW PAR — THIS IS ONE OF THE FEW ASSETS IN THE CORPUS WHERE THE RATIO IS BOTH A REAL MEASUREMENT AND ADVERSE. collateral_ratio 91.21 with surplus_deficit −$1,325,631.79 against total_backing $13,758,936.23. ⚠️ THAT IS NOT AN ACCOUNTING IDENTITY — unlike usdat, susds and the syrup pools, where backing is DEFINED as the supply and the ratio cannot print anything but ~100, here reserve assets and liabilities are independently determined, SO 91.21% CARRIES INFORMATION AND THE INFORMATION IS A SHORTFALL. ⚠️ CUT FROM 5.0. On-chain verified 2026-07-23 and cross-checked against Mento's own published figures rather than taken from one side. ⚠️ COVERAGE IS AGGREGATE ACROSS THE MENTO RESERVE, NOT RING-FENCED PER STABLE — a USDm holder's claim is on a shared pool, so the 91.21% is not a per-asset coverage figure.
backing.backing_score_persistence: filtered — reserve composition; the ratio itself is spot-responsive
backing.backing_score_denominator: ✅ ASK WHAT THE RATIO DIVIDES BY — here it is the good case: reserve assets over stablecoin liabilities, two independently determined quantities. ⚠️ BUT THE NUMERATOR IS SHARED ACROSS MENTO'S STABLE SET, so this is aggregate coverage and NOT a claim about USDm specifically.

liquidity.liquidity_score_basis: ⚠️ MEASURES WHETHER AN EXIT EXISTS, AND THE HEADLINE POOL IS INCENTIVIZED BUT NOT USED. $509K Mento FPMM USDC/USDm pool on Monad paying ~16.7% APY via Merkl — ⚠️⚠️ WITH 24-HOUR VOLUME OF $0. A pool that pays to exist and transacts nothing is not exit liquidity; it is TVL. ⚠️ AN INCENTIVE-SUSTAINED POOL HAS A DURABILITY QUESTION ATTACHED THAT A NATURALLY-FORMED ONE DOES NOT: the depth is contingent on the campaign continuing, and zero volume means nothing is testing whether it would clear. Thin elsewhere.
liquidity.liquidity_score_persistence: filtered — venue structure and incentive durability, not spot depth
liquidity.liquidity_score_depth_caveat: ⚠️ THE FEED COMPUTES NO DEPTH FOR THIS ASSET (`total_2pct_depth: null`), so this authored 5.0 has nothing beside it to agree or disagree with. ⚠️ AND A COMPUTED BAND WOULD NOT HAVE HELPED HERE: a 2% depth probe measures what a pool WOULD absorb, not whether anyone has ever traded it. $0 of 24h volume is invisible to a depth ladder.

dependencies.underlying_score_basis: MEASURES THE COUNTERPARTY SET BEHIND A SHARED RESERVE. USDm's claim is on the AGGREGATE Mento Reserve, so its dependencies include the other stables drawing on the same pool — a holder is exposed to redemptions they are not party to. ⚠️ THIS IS WHY COVERAGE AND DEPENDENCIES ARE NOT THE SAME QUESTION HERE: the 91.21% is a fact about the pool, and this axis prices who else can draw on it.

issuer.issuer_score_basis: MEASURES THE ENTITY AND ITS DISCLOSURE, AND IT IS THE SECOND-HIGHEST SCORE ON AN ASSET WHOSE RESERVE IS BELOW PAR. Doxxed Mento Labs team, direct cLabs lineage, $10M Hashkey-led raise, ChainSecurity audits. ⚠️ A STRONG ISSUER SCORE IS NOT A MITIGANT FOR A 91.21% RATIO — it says the team is identifiable and has been audited, not that the reserve is whole. Scoring the shortfall more leniently because the issuer is credible would be the exact move this frame separates axes to prevent.
